purpose: Task-owned resource allowlist. reset and cleanup operations MUST refuse any resource not matched by this file. Matching is by exact repo-relative path prefix or container-name prefix; nothing outside these rules may be deleted, reset or modified.

rules: Paths are resolved relative to the repository root and normalized; '..' escapes are rejected before any comparison.
Only paths that resolve inside an owned_path_prefixes entry are task-owned.
Tracked repository files are never task-owned, even under an owned prefix.
Directories are removed recursively only after the owned check passes for the resolved real path.
Any container whose name does not start with an owned prefix is refused, including stop/rm.
Container operations are coordinator-executed; the local environment has no Docker socket.

network.owned_namespaces: network namespaces created for a single check run; destroyed when the run exits
rules: Lab runs never create or modify host network configuration.
Isolation checks may only deny connectivity; they must not open host listeners reachable from outside.
Check payloads run only inside an isolated namespace and are killed with it.
No lab step may signal or inspect processes it did not start.
